title: Research sprint goal: Tools read revisions, worktrees and the index key right on any host
goal: The sprint goal's questions whose pack coverage is weak or none are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, written as kb facts (or gap entries) through /kb-research: (1) git cat-file blob REV:PATH versus git show REV:PATH and core.longpaths for long paths on Windows (weak); (2) how git resolves a relative gitdir: path in a .git file or worktree gitdir file (weak); (3) what git update-index --assume-unchanged and --skip-worktree mean for the index entry and a local edit (weak); (4) how Python reports compile-time warnings such as SyntaxWarning for an invalid escape sequence and how a check turns them into errors (-W error, warnings filters, compile()) (none). The Get-MpPerformanceReport -Raw duration unit (pack good, but no cited line names the unit) is left to ST-iivqx6kr, which carries it; the kb_mcp registration question (Q: claude mcp add scope local project registered server path) is good.
